record.title: Microduck banana PCB locker — the 'banana_pcb_locker' mesh of Pollen's MJCF: 54 x 1.5 x 6.6 mm retaining bar with two Ø2.17 M2 holes in Ø4 eyes, a 12 mm notch and two 2.5 x 2.3 x 2 key tabs
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-banana-pcb-locker, 2026-09-01) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/banana_pcb_locker.stl: p95 surface distance 0.013 mm both ways (max 0.227, at the notch fillets), bbox delta [-0.035, 0.0, -0.026] mm, 2/2 holes matched (Ø2.174). Round 1 PASS; the report is the ledger artifact.
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cad-mjcf sections/probe and cecad.meshfeatures; nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.source_reference: reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/banana_pcb_locker.stl (Onshape doc 804927696f06d877f3f1803e, exported by onshape-to-robot); placed in body trunk_base at pos (4, -0.5, -17.5) mm, quat wxyz (0.707, 0, 0, 0.707) per spec/mesh-placements.json
record.why_this_folder_exists: The bar that bolts to the power_support's two Ø3.9 screw pins and clamps the 'banana' battery-contact PCB; its notch is the same 12 mm notch (centre x = -4) the power_support's head carries.
